import os

from cyhole.solscan import Solscan

TOKEN_ADDRESS = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"  # replace with the target token mint address

api_key = os.environ["SOLSCAN_API_KEY"]

solscan = Solscan(api_v2_key=api_key)

response = solscan.client.get_token_price(TOKEN_ADDRESS)

for entry in response.data:
    print(entry.date, entry.price)
